items.stem: What is the recommended sequencing for partner positioning?

options.text: Start with the job to be done, prefer native options first, go custom when proprietary logic, internal systems, or partner IP require it.
Always build custom so the partner controls the code.
Pick whichever construct the stakeholder names first.

items.stem: Which statement about MCP inside Agent Builder is accurate?

options.text: MCP tools are not available as individual single-step selections in Agent Builder.
MCP tools can be selected as any single discrete step in Agent Builder.
MCP is unsupported anywhere in Glean.

items.stem: A requirement needs approvals and custom business logic before writing to a system. What fits?
When is MCP the right call for an agent design?

options.text: When the agent needs dynamic tool choice across a connected toolset and broad interoperability.
When exactly one fixed endpoint is called the same way every run.
When no external systems are involved.

items.stem: Which pairing of native and custom is correct?

options.text: Native: built-in Jira creation template. Custom: internal approval workflow action.
Native: partner-authored delivery methodology. Custom: Glean platform skill.
Native: customer-hosted internal MCP server. Custom: verified GitHub MCP server.
